subtitle: A personal watchlist for open-source projects
description: Search public GitHub repositories, pin and reorder your favorites, inspect recent pull requests and releases, and keep a local watchlist across restarts. Repo Radar uses its own Rust WebAssembly component for public networking, parsing, caching and persistence. Requires a compatible OctoSense host with native Makepad D3 charts and the component HTTPS fix. Optional chat uses your OctoSense app agent and configured model. No GitHub account is required; pinning does not star a repository on GitHub. Activity is a bounded sample, not complete history.
release_notes: Initial public repository watchlist with Rust component networking.
